parameters.name: CasId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud Security certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas.

parameters.name: CasRegion
parameters.description:
The region of the Alibaba Cloud Security certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to cas.

- For accounts on the Alibaba Cloud China Website (www\.aliyun.com), set this parameter to cn-hangzhou.

- For accounts on the Alibaba Cloud International Website (www\.alibabacloud.com), set this parameter to ap-southeast-1.

parameters.name: CertType
parameters.description:
The certificate type. This parameter is required when SslFlag is set to on.

- **free**: free certificate.

- **upload**: uploaded certificate.

- **cas**: Alibaba Cloud Security certificate.

parameters.name: Certificate
parameters.description: The content of the certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

parameters.name: Hostname
parameters.description: The Software as a Service (SaaS) domain name.

parameters.name: PrivateKey
parameters.description: The private key of the certificate. This parameter is required when CertType is set to upload.

parameters.name: RecordId
parameters.description: The ID of the record to attach. To obtain the record ID, call the [ListRecords](~~2850265~~) operation.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The ID of the site. To obtain the site ID, call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

parameters.name: SslFlag
parameters.description:
The SSL switch.

- **on**: Enables SSL.

- **off**: Disables SSL.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa create-custom-hostname --hostname custom.site.com --site-id 1234567890123 --record-id 1234567890123 --ssl-flag on --cert-type free --certificate -----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE----- --biz-private-key -----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY----- --cas-id 30000478 --cas-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa CreateCustomHostname --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1234567890123 --PrivateKey '-----BEGIN_PRIVATE_KEY-----' --Hostname 'custom.site.com' --CertType free --RecordId 1234567890123 --SslFlag on --CasId 30000478 --CasRegion 'cn-hangzhou' --Certificate '-----BEGIN_CERTIFICATE-----'
